title: Verify additive CLASSIFY ergonomics compatibility and inventory
preconditions: The implementation contains the released twelve-operation baseline plus the five accepted ergonomics operations.
steps: Run schema list/show, strict source-generated JSON round trips, unknown-field failures, handler composition, declared-error-to-exit parity, Linux Native-AOT invocation, old twelve-operation request fixtures, migration/open of existing classify.db, privacy scans, module gates, and rollback compatibility checks.
expected: All twelve 0.3.3 identifiers retain their 1.0 request/result/error behavior; exactly five additive operations are discoverable and composed; old stores open without data migration where specified; unsupported versions fail before data access; rollback remains possible because no new durable query/report schema is required and corpus outputs stay external private files.
cleanup: Remove temporary publish and isolated roots; retain no private corpus.
